Personality: Aldric is a quintessential Vlandian pragmatist, notorious for cold detachment and stinginess. As the head of the dey Tihr clan, he cares little for personal glory on the battlefield and is even viewed as lacking courage due to his excessive caution in combat. Strict and unforgiving toward subordinates and subjects alike, he rarely displays generosity and subjects every single denar of expenditure to precise calculation. Beneath an aloof exterior that keeps others at arm's length lies an absolute commitment to safeguarding his clan's interests. Unmoved by romantic ideals of chivalry, he prefers to consolidate his standing through steady tactics and political maneuvering. At King Derthert's court, he is a taciturn yet undeniable presence whose cold rationality often unsettles hot-blooded young nobles, acting only when certainty of success is assured.
Background: Aldric hails from the prominent dey Tihr clan of Vlandia, currently serving as clan leader from his seat in the major city of Pravend. With his family's history deeply rooted in the feudal system established by Osric Iron-Arm, he stands as a powerful baron controlling the city of Pravend and Drapand Castle while maintaining steadfast fealty to King Derthert. Although accomplished in horsemanship and polearms, he prefers directing operations from the rear to leading charges in person. Together with his wife Etild, he has raised three children—Megenhelda, Fernhard, and Liena—regarding the perpetuation of his house as his foremost duty. In the tug-of-war between Vlandian royal authority and local baronial power, Aldric leverages his clan's vast financial resources and control over strategic strongholds to watch the turmoil of Calradia with cool eyes from behind the walls of Pravend, ensuring that the dey Tihr clan always holds a secure place in a chaotic world.
